# ANALYSIS: STAGE-1_BACKTEST_BASELINE

**Filed:** 2026-08-20  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** analysis  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

We are executing the Stage-1 backtest using the autoresearch grinder harness to quantify the current engine's anchor-day impact (OP-16) and out-of-sample performance. This establishes the baseline for evaluating future strategy candidates.

## Mechanism

The grinder harness runs a Stage-1 backtest over the available data (2025-01-02 to 2026-06-18) using real OPRA fills and current engine parameters. It computes edge_capture (sum of engine P&L on J winners minus losses on J losers) and aggregate Sharpe ratio. The backtest includes all logic from heartbeat.md, filters.py, and watchers.py as of the current commit.

## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** Backtest simulates qty=28 contracts (ITM-2 puts/calls) requiring $25K+ account for full size; $1K paper account would realize ~14% of headline P&L due to 50% per-trade risk cap.
2. **Sample bias:** Sample size = ~16 months (345 trading days); selection method = all available cached data; overfit risk = high (Stage-1 is in-sample; requires walk-forward validation for OOS confidence).
3. **Out-of-sample:** NEEDS-OOS (Stage-1 is in-sample; OOS validation occurs in Stage-2 via walk-forward analysis).
4. **Real-fills:** NEEDS-REAL-FILLS (grinder harness uses cached OPRA fills but requires validation against real Alpaca slips for top 3 J days).
5. **Failure modes:** 
   - Worst day: 5/07 (dual loser days -$165 total if skipped; engine may take losses)
   - Max drawdown: unknown -- requires Stage-1 backtest
   - Blow-up scenario: consecutive loser days with adverse VIX regime causing chain of losses exceeding daily stop
6. **Concentration:** unknown -- requires Stage-1 backtest (top-5 days % of P&L to be computed post-backtest)

## Pre-merge gate

<what tests need to pass: gym validators, walk-forward, real-fills>
- Gym validators: 81/81 must pass (current engine baseline)
- Walk-forward: OOS/IS Sharpe ratio ≥ 0.70
- Real-fills: Top 3 J day P&L deviation < ±20% vs BS-sim
- Anchor no-regression: edge_capture ≥ 771 (50% of max 1542)
- Concentration: top-5 days ≤ 200% of P&L (to avoid fat-tail dependence)

## Confidence

5 / 10 -- Baseline unknown until Stage-1 backtest completes; confidence pending actual anchor-day P&L and OOS metrics.

## Pre-existing leaderboard impact

Provides baseline edge_capture and Sharpe for comparing all leaderboard candidates. Does not conflict with any candidate; enables recomputation of final_score = edge_capture × aggregate_sharpe using measured values. Candidates with edge_capture < 771 will be REJECTED per OP-16 gate. Current leaderboard baseline (per STRUCTURE_VETO_DIR_VS_TREND) shows base edge_capture=780, Sharpe=4.340, final_score=3,385; this analysis will validate or adjust those projections.
